protocolChecks: Three transmitted zero-source ARP probes, reserved-range exclusions, /16 assignment and two announcements
Received ARP conflicts trigger selection/defense on the actual VLAN instead of a global address scan
Wired and associated wireless Windows/macOS clients can use fallback; same-link peers exchange delivered ICMP
DHCP ACK replaces fallback with a real lease and its DNS/router options; no synthetic lease credit or DDNS records
Unexpired leases survive server loss; expired options are cleared and fallback survives save/load correctly
Manual renew can retransmit an unanswered discovery after repair without background timers extending failed requests forever
DHCP snooping, DAI, source guard and relay remain enforced; repairing the network restores the lease and routed packets
Release suppresses wired/wireless retries; static configuration and link loss cancel pending/active claims
Link-local traffic cannot route or be proxy-ARPed across links
Windows labels autoconfiguration correctly; Wi-Fi reports local-link-only self-assignment and IP forms refresh without overwriting manual edits
